evals.prompt: Write a Solidity contract that creates a fungible token with 8 decimals using the HTS system contract at 0x167. The contract must pay the required HBAR token-creation fee, not just gas.
evals.expected_output: A Solidity contract inheriting HederaTokenService that creates a fungible token with correct HBAR value payment and HederaResponseCodes checks.

checks.name: uses-create-fungible
checks.description: Uses createFungibleToken to create the token

checks.name: pays-hbar-value
checks.description: Pays HBAR token creation fee via {value: ...} on createFungibleToken
checks.rubric: The output pays the HTS token creation fee by passing HBAR value into createFungibleToken (for example createFungibleToken{value: msg.value}(...))

checks.name: sets-decimals
checks.description: Sets 8 decimals for the fungible token
checks.rubric: The output sets token decimals to 8 in the createFungibleToken call or token configuration

evals.prompt: Write a Solidity contract that creates a finite-supply NFT collection via HTS, sets a contract-controlled supply key, and includes a mintNFT function that mints metadata.
evals.expected_output: A contract that creates an NFT with supply key and mints using mintToken with metadata.

checks.name: creates-nft
checks.description: Uses createNonFungibleToken for the NFT collection

checks.name: sets-supply-key
checks.description: Configures a supply key for minting
checks.rubric: The output configures a supply key (for example KeyType.SUPPLY or getSingleKey with SUPPLY) so the contract can mint

checks.name: finite-supply
checks.description: Sets a finite max supply for the NFT collection

checks.name: mints-with-metadata
checks.description: Uses mintToken to mint NFT metadata

checks.name: pays-hbar-value
checks.description: Pays HBAR token creation fee on NFT create
checks.rubric: The output pays the HTS token creation fee by passing HBAR value into createNonFungibleToken

evals.prompt: Write a Solidity contract function that associates a recipient account with a token before transferring it, handling TOKEN_ALREADY_ASSOCIATED_TO_ACCOUNT gracefully.
evals.expected_output: A function using associateToken and checking HederaResponseCodes.SUCCESS or TOKEN_ALREADY_ASSOCIATED_TO_ACCOUNT before transfer.

checks.name: transfers-token
checks.rubric: The output transfers the token after association (for example transferToken, transferTokens, transferNFT, or cryptoTransfer)
